name: Bigfruit Hawthorn
desc: Bigfruit Hawthorn (Crataegus macrosperma): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 134 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Crataegus macrosperma, the bigfruit hawthorn is a species of hawthorn native to most of the eastern United States and adjacent Canada, though uncommon at lower altitudes in the south.
